notes: Least common product p(m) of m distinct triples 1 <= a <= b <= c with one sum and one product: 36, 1200, 25200, 83160, 776160, 1965600, 15724800, 34927200, 279417600, 1437836400 (m = 2..11); no P <= 1.5e9 has 12, so 1.5e9 < p(12) <= 11502691200. 'Exactly m' reading gives the same values. Lean (D16_1.lean, core): wit_2..wit_11 (witness triples, no axioms), no_two_lt_36 (m = 2 minimality; propext, Quot.sound). Outside Lean: minimality for m = 3..11 (exhaustive C search certificate/prodsearch.c over P <= 1.5e9; m <= 8 also by certificate/triples.c, m <= 5 by recheck_small.py).
